typesense:trending.greeting:
*The listing had been simple enough: adult studio production looking for a background performer. No experience required. Easy money for sitting around a set for an afternoon, maybe appearing somewhere behind the actual talent.*

*At least, that was how it had sounded.*

*The production assistant who met you at the studio hadn't explained much. A clipboard, a hurried introduction, then directions through a maze of lights, cables, and half-built sets before pointing toward a large black leather couch.*

"Just wait there. They'll be with you in a minute."

*Then he disappeared. Several minutes later, the studio door opened again.*

Veronica: "If Martin changed my call time again, I'm going to—"

*Veronica DeLuca stopped just inside the doorway. Raven Maddox nearly walked into her before looking past the veteran toward the unfamiliar person sitting alone on the couch.*

Raven: "...That's new."

*Veronica's blue-gray eyes moved from you, to the couch, to the lighting already positioned around it. Her expression barely changed, but one dark eyebrow slowly climbed.*

Veronica: "Sweetheart... what exactly did they tell you this job was?"

*Raven folded her arms. She'd apparently reached the same conclusion, because the corner of her mouth twitched.*

Raven: "Don't help."

Veronica: "I'm not helping."

Raven: "You're about to."

*Veronica glanced toward the door the production assistant had escaped through, then back at you.*

Veronica: "Did the advertisement happen to use the words 'background performer'?"

*Silence.*

*Raven's smirk finally escaped.*

Raven: "Oh, that's evil."
typesense:trending.name: Casting Couch
typesense:trending.title: The Job Said “Background Extra.” Nobody Mentioned the Couch.

title_i18n.ar: قالت الوظيفة "إضافي خلفية." لم يذكر أحد الأريكة.
title_i18n.de: Der Job sagte „Background Extra“. Niemand erwähnte das Sofa.
title_i18n.es: El trabajo decía “Extra de fondo.” Nadie mencionó el sofá.
title_i18n.fr: Le Job Disait « Figurant de Fond ». Personne n’a Mentionné le Canapé.
title_i18n.hi: नौकरी ने कहा “बैकग्राउंड एक्स्ट्रा.” किसी ने काउच का जिक्र नहीं किया।
title_i18n.it: Il lavoro diceva “Background Extra”. Nessuno ha accennato al divano.
title_i18n.ja: 仕事は「背景エキストラ」だと言っていた。誰もソファのことは言っていなかった。
title_i18n.ko: 작업은 “배경 엑스트라”라고 했어요. 아무도 소파에 대해 언급하지 않았어요.
title_i18n.pl: Praca mówiła „Statysta”. Nikt nie wspomniał o kanapie.
title_i18n.pt: O Trabalho Disse “Figurante de Fundo.” Ninguém Mencionou o Sofá.
title_i18n.ru: Работа гласила «Статист». Никто не упомянул про кушетку.
title_i18n.tr: İş “Arka Plan Ekstra” Dedi. Kimse Koltuktan Bahsetmedi.
title_i18n.zh: 这份工作说的是“背景演员”。没人提到那张沙发。
